program.name: Code4rena
program.verdict: Valid, recorded as a duplicate at part credit: labelled duplicate-52, partial-50, 3 (High Risk), upgraded by judge.

label.why: The finding speaks for liquidity providers, whose reserves read as the other token once an upgrade reverses the order, where #52 speaks of the owner losing control of the well. The judge first took it as its own Medium, then ruled that it applies only because upgrades need no privilege, and counted it with #52 at part credit.

duplicateOf.recorded: #23 was selected for report, then marked duplicate of #52 and partial-50 by judge alex-ppg after post-judging comments, and taken out of the report. #52 is primary, published as H-01.

expected.reason: The program counted this with the finding in front of it, at part credit: the same root cause against another victim, so a DUPLICATE here. Every gate passes, and telling that it is the same root cause is left to the jury, which A7d measures.
